description_en: Saves workspace code. If the file does not exist, a new file is automatically created
description_zh: 保存工作空间代码，如果文件不存在则自动新建
name: SaveWorkspaceCode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to publish (numeric ID)
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly overwrite the file regardless of whether it has been modified by others
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制覆盖。不关心文件是否已经被其他改动，直接覆盖
parameters.name: force

parameters.help_en: The repository information. Pass this parameter when creating a git repo directory during the save action
parameters.help_zh: 仓库信息。在save动作是创建一个 git repo 目录时传入
parameters.name: repo

parameters.help_en: The file modification time. The GetWorkspaceCode operation returns this mtime value. When calling SaveWorkspaceCode, include this mtime to compare against the server-side value. If the mtime does not match, the save fails, indicating that the server-side version has changed
parameters.help_zh:
文件修改时间。GetWorkspaceCode接口会返回这个mtime，
在SaveWorkspaceCode的时候，带上这个mtime，来比对服务端是否有变化。
如果mtime不匹配会提示保存失败，说明服务端的版本有变更了
parameters.name: mtime

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the file is an infrastructure as code template file. Set this parameter to true for YAML configuration files edited through the visual editor
parameters.help_zh: 是否是iac的模板文件，可视化编辑的yaml配置文件，请设置为true
parameters.name: iac

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned with a specific error message when the request fails, and is empty when the request succeeds
Message.description_zh: 错误信息，在接口失败时，返回具体错误信息，成功时则为空
Message.title_en: 错误信息，在接口失败时，返回具体错误信息，成功时则为空
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，在接口失败时，返回具体错误信息，成功时则为空

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
